notes.title: My new project - Wilderwind (thunderclap link at the bottom)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8498860/eb687a7af613b5807b6831adbf04407ebdc3c7f5.png[/img]

[b]I will launch my Kickstarter campaign for my game Wilderwind on May 8th.[/b] It would help me a lot if you contribute and help spread the word with a Tweet, Facebook post or Tumblr post on the day of the launch.

[b]Any support for my projects means a lot.[/b]
As a one person indie studio I don't get a lot of exposure, I'm no expert at marketing either, I just want to make great and fun games! Not spend all my days trying to get the word out. With your help I can reach people, many people, and let them know about Wilderwind!
[b]Anyone helping spread the word is a winner in my book and is truly helping this project become a reality[/b] by maximizing chances of a successful campaign. You have my thanks in advance for any support.

For those who are wondering what type of videogame Wilderwind is, it is an Online multiplayer survival rpg set in a world full of magic and danger. Where woodland creatures walk and act as humans would.

[url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/56487-wilderwind]https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/56487-wilderwind[/url]


My twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/PowrUptoMaximum]@PowrUptoMaximum[/url]
